name: Volume-Sampled Antialiasing
definition: A 3D object-space antialiasing technique that performs antialiasing once on a 3D view-independent representation during the modeling stage to produce alias-free 3D models stored in a volume buffer.
summary: Volume-Sampled Antialiasing is a 3D object-space technique that produces alias-free models by storing continuous density values in a volume buffer, unlike binary voxelization.
